detail.longDescription: How can I implement video streaming using Java, Spring Boot, and Amazon S3? I’m trying to build a video streaming application similar to YouTube using Java and Spring Boot. I have some basic theoretical knowledge of HLS and MPEG-DASH, but I’m struggling to understand how to implement them in practice, and I haven’t found many useful articles or tutorials. My initial idea is to store videos in an Amazon S3 bucket, retrieve them in chunks through my Spring Boot backend, and send those chunks to the frontend. The architecture would look something like this: Amazon S3 → Spring Boot → Frontend However, I’m not sure whether this is the right approach or if there’s a more efficient way to handle video streaming. Is routing video chunks through Spring Boot a good approach, or should the frontend retrieve them directly from S3?
